description: Altermagnetic alpha-MnTe GW (GTH TZDP10 matched basis, nspin=2).

basis_family.per_system_override_rule: Use the validated GTH TZDP10 matched basis set for alpha-MnTe.
basis_family.rationale: The altermagnet identity is frozen on the GTH TZDP10 matched basis.

nao_family.per_system_override_rule: Keep the 10au TZDP NAO family that the reference uses.
nao_family.rationale: The frozen reference uses the GTH TZDP10 set.

exx_cs_inv_thr.per_system_override_rule: Use an explicit small threshold; Mn is a 3d heavy element and the automatic cutoff breaks EXX.
exx_cs_inv_thr.rationale: Heavy 3d elements make the Cs inverse ill-conditioned; the automatic cutoff produces garbage EXX.

screening_kgrid.per_system_override_rule: Use a regular Gamma-centred mesh matching the SCF run.
screening_kgrid.rationale: Screening definition must match the producer mesh.

nfreq.per_system_override_rule: Use a moderately dense frequency grid.
nfreq.rationale: Magnetic systems need a denser grid than the smallest smoke cases.

nbands.per_system_override_rule: Set nbands equal to nbasis; an altermagnet has two spin channels so nbasis is roughly doubled.
nbands.rationale: An incomplete state space corrupts EXX/GW.
